image_description: A vintage, dark-colored (likely black or dark brown) typewriter viewed from a slightly elevated front angle. The image focuses on the keyboard and carriage area. The space bar is the long, horizontal key at the bottom center of the keyboard layout. The keys appear to be round or square with rounded corners, typical of older typewriter designs. The lighting is somewhat dim, creating reflections on the glossy surfaces of the typewriter body.
